changes.current: Nine new Stage-1 checkpoints are trained on this experiment's reference payoff labels with source ATM IV/HV fallback and piecewise-linear zero rates. The earlier V3 affine-coupon ensemble is also evaluated unchanged as a separate prior-frozen comparator. No Stage 2 or PI loss is used.
